test_tsfeatures_transform: test the TsFeatures transform method to extract statistical and seasonal features from a univariate time series
test_tsfeatures_multivariate: test the TsFeatures transform method on multivariate time series data and verify per-column feature extraction
test_tsfeatures_selected_features: test the TsFeatures class with selected_features to compute only a subset of features like var and linearity
test_tsfeatures_extension_features: test the TsFeatures class with extension features like cusum_detector, bocp_detector, and nowcasting features
test_tsfeatures_fourier: test the TsFourierFeatures class to compute Fourier sine and cosine features from time series timestamps
